title: Semiya Upma
description: Roasted vermicelli cooked with mustard seeds, curry leaves and vegetables into a soft, fluffy upma.
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and crackle the mustard seeds, then fry the urad dal until golden.
Add the curry leaves, green chilli and onion and sauté for 3 minutes until translucent.
Stir in the carrot and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the 350 ml of water, add the salt and bring to a rolling boil.
Add the roasted vermicelli, stir well, cover and cook on low heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Turn off the heat, squeeze in the lemon juice and fluff with a fork before serving.
